title: Transferring Resonant Blowup to the Full Einstein System
exact_target: Can a blowup mechanism in the resonant approximation be proved to occur in the full Einstein evolution?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30002920 (OWR-13854-004). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical Aspects of General Relativity (2015), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2015/33, pp. 1867--1935. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 17.
Bizon--Maliborski--Rostworowski, Resonant dynamics and instability of AdS (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).
Moschidis, instability results for Einstein--Vlasov (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The extraction does not supply the resonant equations, matter model, gauge or blowup norm. These must be recovered from the report; the phrase full system does not identify a standalone PDE by itself.
